name: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation
zh: 中国航天科技集团有限公司

evidence.summary: SASTIND lists CASC among China’s defence-industry group companies (军工集团). CASC says it researches, designs, builds, tests and launches strategic missiles, tactical missiles and unmanned systems as well as launch vehicles, satellites and crewed spacecraft; its research academies include the China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology and the China Academy of Space Technology.

CASC describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise and a cornerstone of China’s national security strategy, founded in 1999 and descended from the Ministry of National Defense’s Fifth Academy, founded in 1956.
